scenarios.title: Fresh-extreme ladder
scenarios.description: New highs and lows update only the affected boundary.

scenarios.title: Rolling-window expiry
scenarios.description: A boundary changes when its owning extreme leaves the window.

scenarios.title: Tied-extreme boundary
scenarios.description: The value survives until the last tied extreme expires.

scenarios.title: Flat channel
scenarios.description: Upper, lower, and middle coincide with zero width.

scenarios.title: Current-window versus prior-window boundary
scenarios.description: The current high can equal the current-inclusive upper channel; breakout logic must compare with a prior completed channel.

scenarios.title: Responsive ten-bar channel
scenarios.description: A shorter window accepts and expires extrema faster.
